notes: This snapshot lists skills verified as actually active in a live Claude Code session on 2026-08-02.

Entries present in Claude/skills/SKILLS_CATALOG.yaml but not re-verified this run (ultrareview, ultraplan, team-onboarding, effort, powerup, tui, focus, undo, usage, theme, color) are intentionally omitted from this snapshot pending source verification.
